feed_description: Machine-readable change log for the T4127 engine and the public calculators.

items.title: Unreleased — embeddable take-home widget
items.summary: One script tag, same T4127 WASM engine, no cookie and no salary posted back. Demo and a pitch for job boards, recruiters, and relocation services at /embed/.

items.title: Unreleased — five-minute API path
items.summary: Docs in the header. Email, verify, test key, first call. Ontario weekly $1000 on 2026-01-15 returns net_pay 800.79.

items.title: Unreleased — Worker API
items.summary: Cloudflare Worker API (POST /v1/deductions and M3 GET surfaces) over the WASM engine. Unknown fields named; out-of-range as_of rejected; OpenAPI generated from the same schemas.

items.title: Unreleased — self-serve keys and CAD billing
items.summary: np_test_ and np_live_ keys, hashed at rest. Metering counts calculations. Live keys hard-stop at the published CAD plan limit. Signup is email, verify, keys, first call.

items.title: Unreleased — 200 pages, RSS, CPP 2027
items.summary: Site catalog expanded to 200 HTML pages from four templates (employee, employer, situational, reference). /conformance renders the full disagreement list. /changes has an RSS feed. /cpp-2027-rate-change published ahead of the 2027 T4127 edition.

items.title: 0.3.0-m2 — thirteen jurisdictions, 164 M-003 rows
items.summary: Thirteen-jurisdiction T4127 engine (both 2026 editions); Quebec remains typed unsupported. July PDOC queue finished: 8,818/8,982 compared forms; 164 one-cent M-003 disagreements counted; 780 step-2 non-advances named out of the rate. Overall PDOC agreement 8,838/9,002 including M1. Finding 002 remains open.

items.title: 0.2.0-m1 — Ontario PDOC 20/20
items.summary: M0: fixed-point decimal type and CRA rounding rules. M1: Ontario PDOC 20/20.
